name: indie-ios-kit
description: Skills for building, shipping and marketing the indie iOS app portfolio.

plugins.name: indie-ios
plugins.description: The full idea-to-launch skill set for an indie iOS app: ship-app (which skill runs at each phase), new-app (repo template), store-assets (header, search-result and new-device images), first-impression (first-session audit and launch-week plan before 1.0), user-journey (journeys derived from the business, checked in code and walked in the simulator), plus pinned third-party skills for jobs-to-be-done research, acceptance criteria, SwiftUI, TDD, App Store Connect (asc), App Review checks, ASO, launch marketing and 12-month marketing plans.
